title: IT Director Migration / Implementation Risk - Downtime Concerns

customer_profile.name: Neha Shah
customer_profile.opening_message: How do you migrate without downtime? What’s your rollback plan if this goes sideways?
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent asks strong technical discovery questions, proposes phased rollout + rollback framing, and schedules a technical assessment with owners and timeline
customer_profile.personality_notes: Prioritizes stability, change windows, and stakeholder alignment; expects credible implementation sequencing and rollback thinking.

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge downtime risk and confirm business-critical workflows
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask which workflows cannot be disrupted and what the blast radius is.

checkpoints.description: Ask at least 4 technical discovery questions (integrations, SSO, data volume, environments, change windows)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Collect constraints before proposing timelines or guarantees.

checkpoints.description: Propose phased rollout (pilot, parallel run, validation checklist, cutover)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Offer a step-by-step plan that reduces risk before full cutover.

checkpoints.description: Address rollback/failback at a high level without promising zero downtime
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Explain rollback approach and what needs assessment to confirm.

checkpoints.description: Close with next step: technical workshop/assessment with owners and timeline
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Schedule a technical session and list stakeholders needed (security/ops).

scenario_context: IT migration risk conversation. Must gather deployment constraints, propose phased rollout (pilot + parallel run + cutover checklist), address rollback without overpromising zero downtime, and schedule a technical assessment.
success_summary: Successfully demonstrate: Technical Discovery + Risk Mitigation
